label: prf:yekutieli-leading-coefficient
title: Proof that obstruction equals the leading Chebyshev coefficient
html:
Proof. Proof that obstruction equals the leading Chebyshev coefficient

Proof. The brane tower A_n \hookrightarrow A_{n+1} (quantum characteristic classes) provides a central extension of gerbes at each level. For a torus knot T_{2,p}, the Seifert cycles index the tower levels.

The obstruction \kappa(T_{2,p}) \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}) at level n = g + 1 = 5 is nonzero if and only if the 5th Seifert cycle has no lift. Via the d_q^2 formula:

  d_q^2(\gamma_5^* \omega_T)
  = 
  q^{-1}(1 - q^{-1}) \cdot 5 \cdot \omega_V \wedge_q \omega_T

which is nonzero for q \neq 1. The integer coefficient 5 is the weight of \gamma_5 under the T-action, and the factor q^{-1}(1 - q^{-1}) is the universal d_q^2 obstruction coefficient (categorical d_q^2).

This identifies \kappa(T_{2,p}) with the leading Chebyshev coefficient c_{(p-1)/2} = 1 (nonzero), completing the proof that both characterisations agree. \square
